correctness.rationale: Full proof reconstructed: condition on a stationary equilibrium renewal cycle; after a reset, conditional odd mixed moments vanish; without a reset, Gaussian moment expansion is 12D² age×lag. Integrate the joint age/residual law to obtain 6D² lag×E[(T-lag)_+²]/E T. Right second derivatives recover P(T>lag) including atoms, positive initial slope and recovered first/second moments fix D. Spatial parity and stationarity rule out time asymmetry below degree four. Gaussian double-factorial expansion proves the hierarchy for arbitrary integer m with finite E T^(m+2). Independently generated rational-cycle expressions agreed in 899 reproducibility checks, which do not constitute the infinite proof.

The same observable identifies both diffusivity and the complete hidden reset distribution; the all-order positive hierarchy reveals structured higher-moment behavior.
